description: Fields to configure in the voice platform's post-call analysis / data extraction so every test call produces a structured record. Names match the internal state in prompts/system-prompt.md.

fields.name: callback_time
fields.description: Preferred callback time if the customer was busy; empty otherwise.

fields.name: property_type
fields.description: Type of property offered as security.

fields.name: documents_available
fields.description: Original property documents available for verification.

fields.name: loan_amount
fields.description: Final loan amount agreed in the call, at most 75 lakh.

fields.name: requested_loan_amount
fields.description: Amount first requested if it was above 75 lakh.

fields.name: market_value
fields.description: Customer's estimate of the property's current market value.

fields.name: existing_property_loan
fields.description: Customer has an existing loan on the property.

fields.name: emi_reduction_request
fields.description: Customer wants to reduce a current EMI.
